comment: Definitely not an easy A but I'd say an easy B. You can put in more effort if you want but if you show up and study a little you'll be fine

I was not very confident at the start of this class but his teaching really helped me learn a lot and understand the course material. He was always there to answer questions or address concerns. I appreciated how in-depth he covered our class readings and made sure that we understood everything. Would definitely recommend this professor to others
The class was well organized and expectations were clear. Laptops and cell phones aren't allowed but I think that actually helped the discussion. Dr. Payne is really engaging and I learned a lot!

Dr. Payne is the goat. His ability to guide class discussion is amazing and I always left class with a much deeper understanding of the subject matter than when I entered. The semester was well paced and he did a great job incorporating relevant real world events into the learning process.

Dr. Payne is a wonderful professor! He is passionate about the material and caring for his students. Your grade is based on essays, reading responses, and participation. He gives very detailed feedback on papers and is accessible outside of class. He encourages you to think more critically and helps guide you in improving!
